title: Fade Banshee
html:
Shadow Fade Crooner

Fade Banshees are a special breed of Fade casters. Their attacks have a chance to induce the Curse of the Banshee on their victims, which causes the victim to run uncontrollably in fear. The effect disappears after a few seconds, or if the Banshee which casted the spell is killed. A cursed opponent will gain Bravery which gives 6 times the amount of time of fear as immunity to fear effects.

Race: Fade

Class: Mage

Basic Types

Name Element Habitat
Shadow Fade Banshee or Shadow Fade Crooner Shadow Vergrim's Vexation, Crematorium, Frump's Misfortune, level 1 - 4,The Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine, level 5 - 7
